title: Ignatius' Creed
author: Ignatius of Antioch
intro: Not a creed itself but the summary of the gospel facts in Ignatius of Antioch's Epistle to the Trallians, ch. 9 (c. 107). English text as given by Schaff (shorter Greek recension; his bracketed additions from the longer recension omitted).

sections.text: Be deaf, therefore, when any would speak to you apart from (at variance with) Jesus Christ, who was descended from the family of David, born of Mary, who truly was born, ate and drank, truly suffered persecution under Pontius Pilate, was truly crucified and died … who was also truly raised from the dead, his Father raising him up ….
